name: ENCODE_eCLIP
adarpro_decision: Use positive peaks; never interpret Alu peak absence as no binding

name: PrismNet
input_modality: RNA sequence plus in-vivo structural reactivity
cell_specificity: cell-line-specific; relevant precomputed K562 and HepG2
license: repository LICENSE is MIT; README says non-commercial, so commercial status needs clarification
pretrained_or_data_availability: K562 and HepG2 genome-wide prediction ZIPs downloaded and checksummed

name: RBPNet
cell_specificity: one model per HepG2 CLIP task
license: MIT code; Zenodo model record CC-BY-4.0
pretrained_or_data_availability: all 104 frozen models available; exact Zenodo checksum verified
adarpro_decision: Primary sequence-only complement; outputs are not calibrated occupancy probabilities

name: DeepCLIP
human_rbp_coverage: model-dependent; no bundled pretrained-model catalog in repository
output: sequence score and nucleotide binding profile
pretrained_or_data_availability: web tool and trainable code; Python 2.7/Theano/Lasagne runtime
adarpro_decision: Not selected for first pass because frozen panel coverage is not auditable and runtime is legacy

name: RBPmap
input_modality: sequence or genomic coordinates plus motif database
human_rbp_coverage: 132 human/mouse RBP motif entries; 274 motifs across supported species
license: website/package terms not stated on download page
output: motif hits with significance and conservation filters
genome_assembly: hg38 hg19 hg18 and other supported genomes
pretrained_or_data_availability: standalone tarball and MySQL dump available
adarpro_decision: Candidate motif sensitivity layer; weak for motif-poor dsRNA binders

name: RBP2GO_2.0
license: public web resource; reuse terms require checking
output: RBP identity scores functions domains diseases localization-linked evidence
adarpro_decision: Use for biological priors and identity/function audit, not site prediction

name: iDeepB
input_modality: RNA sequence plus cell-line gene expression
human_rbp_coverage: paper reports expression-aware eCLIP benchmarks; downloadable model coverage not established
pretrained_or_data_availability: no maintained model repository identified in current search
adarpro_decision: Track as promising expression-aware alternative; exclude until frozen models are reproducibly available

name: PaRPI
human_rbp_coverage: publication-specific; reusable panel coverage not established
pretrained_or_data_availability: no maintained pretrained-model repository identified in current search
adarpro_decision: Track as future transfer-learning alternative; not included in frozen first pass
